asyntai-desc: Puts the Asyntai AI chat assistant on every page and sends the wiki pages to the Asyntai knowledge base, so the assistant answers from them
right-asyntai-manage: Manage the Asyntai AI Chatbot settings
action-asyntai-manage: manage the Asyntai AI Chatbot settings
asyntai-intro: Paste your Widget ID and the chat assistant appears on every page. Add an API key and turn the sync on, and the assistant answers from the pages of this wiki. Get both at [https://asyntai.com asyntai.com].
asyntai-field-widget-id-help: From the Asyntai dashboard, under Installation. It looks like asyntai_xxxxxxxxxxxx. You can paste the whole script snippet as well.
asyntai-field-widget-id-invalid: That is not a Widget ID. It looks like asyntai_xxxxxxxxxxxx.
asyntai-field-api-key-help: From the Asyntai dashboard, under Settings, then API. The API needs a paid plan. Leave the field empty to keep the stored key.
asyntai-field-sync-enabled-help: New and changed pages go to the knowledge base as they are saved. Deleted pages are removed from it.
asyntai-field-namespaces-help: Namespace numbers, separated by commas. 0 is the main namespace. Add 12 for Help, or 4 for Project pages.
asyntai-field-website-id-help: Only needed when your Asyntai account has more than one website. Leave it empty otherwise.
asyntai-status-tracked: Pages in the Asyntai knowledge base: $1
asyntai-status-queued: Pages waiting in the job queue: $1
asyntai-sync-all-help: Queues every page in the chosen namespaces. Pages that did not change since they were last sent are skipped. The jobs run in the background as visitors open pages, or at once with maintenance/runJobs.php.
asyntai-sync-needs-key: Save an API key and turn the sync on first.
asyntai-error-limit: The Asyntai daily upload limit was reached. The sync continues tomorrow.
asyntai-error-auth: Asyntai refused the API key (HTTP $1). Check the key and the plan.
